assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code for unspecified atrial fibrillation is I48.91
The diagnosis code for persistent palpitations is R00.2
The palpitations have not been adequately characterized by standard short-term monitoring
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated
The 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is coded as CPT 93247
The 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is medically necessary to characterize the arrhythmia burden consistent with the clinical indication
